title: Judge verdict (harness-neutral)
description: The judge's decision on one PR head, the last JSON block of the judge session's final message. The runner turns a MERGE into a REJECT when any change has a null criterion, and refuses a MERGE with an empty changes list or a criterion that does not quote the task.

verdict.description: HOLD: the diff makes a change no criterion asks for, but the change is plausibly fine; the owner decides.

changes.description: Every behaviour change in the diff, including failure paths, defaults, limits, timers and changes to code or styles that other callers or pages share.

change.description: The change, quoting the diff line(s) that make it.

criterion.description: A word-for-word quote of the task criterion or spec requirement that asks for this change (never a proof command); null when nothing in the task asks for it.
